method.segmentation: OBSERVED: ffmpeg 7.1.5 scdet-style scene filter on 320x180 downscale, threshold 0.2, full duration; 48 cut points, 49 segments, no gaps
method.frames: midpoint frame per segment extracted at 640x360 (ffmpeg fast seek); vision-model descriptions (glm-4.5v via z-ai CLI) with hand curation and redaction
method.pixelMetrics: PIL 11.3 median-cut 8-color quantization share + Rec.601 mean luma per midpoint frame
method.motion: 5 fps 160x90 grayscale consecutive-frame mean abs diff; interior mean per segment; cut classification by diff profile (spike vs ramp)
method.narration: ASR transcription of the AAC mono track in 17 silence-aligned chunks (max 30 s each; service limit); narration pauses via ffmpeg silencedetect -38dB/0.45s
method.alignment: distance from each scene-cut time to the nearest narration-pause boundary
method.caveats: vision-model text transcription is instrument output, not ground truth; only clearly-legible designed/structured text is committed as exactTexts; credential-like in-video values are never transcribed (marked sensitive)
